sintoma: Chamado #4301 — Logs do edge e do firewall “não batem” no horário. Equipe suspeita de ataque; relógios divergem em horas.
cli_output:
Edge# show ntp status
Clock is unsynchronized, stratum 16, no reference clock
nominal freq is 250.0000 Hz, actual freq is 250.0000 Hz, precision is 2**10
reference time is 00000000.00000000 (00:00:00.000 UTC Mon Jan 1 1900)

Edge# show ntp associations
  address         ref clock       st   when   poll   reach  delay  offset   disp
 ~203.0.113.10    .INIT.          16      -     64      0     0.0    0.0  16000
 * master (synced), # master (unsynced), + selected, - candidate, ~ configured

Edge# show run | include ntp
ntp server 203.0.113.10

Edge# show logging | include time|Log Buffer
No time-source configured or time not synchronized
Log Buffer (8192 bytes):
*Mar  1 02:11:44.201: %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet0/1, changed state to up

Edge# ping 203.0.113.10
..... Success rate is 0 percent (0/5)
alternativas: show ntp status indica synchronized stratum 1
ping ao servidor NTP 100% prova alcance
ntp server ausente na running-config
Clock unsynchronized stratum 16, association ~ sem reach, ping 0% — fonte NTP configurada mas inalcançável/unsync
explicacao_profunda: status unsynchronized/stratum 16; association com reach 0 e .INIT.; ping ao 203.0.113.10 falha. A linha ntp server existe — o problema é alcance/serviço, não ausência de comando. Timestamps de log ficam não confiáveis até haver sync.

sintoma: Chamado #4302 — Servidor Syslog quase vazio; só raríssimas mensagens “emergency”. No device, show logging mostra errors e warnings no buffer.
cli_output:
R1# show run | include logging
service timestamps log datetime msec
logging buffered 16384 warnings
logging host 10.255.255.50
logging trap emergencies
logging console warnings

R1# show logging
Syslog logging: enabled (0 messages dropped, 0 flushes, 0 overruns)
    Console logging: level warnings, 42 messages logged
    Buffer logging: level warnings, 38 messages logged
    Trap logging: level emergencies, 2 message lines logged
        Logging to 10.255.255.50 (udp port 514, audit disabled,
              link up), 2 message lines logged
Log Buffer (16384 bytes):
*Aug 12 10:01:02.111: %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet0/0, changed state to down
*Aug 12 10:01:05.200: %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface GigabitEthernet0/0, changed state to down
*Aug 12 10:02:11.004: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin

R1# show ntp status
Clock is synchronized, stratum 3, reference is 10.0.0.1
alternativas: NTP unsync explica a ausência total de buffer local
logging trap emergencies restringe o host a severidade 0 — errors/notifications no buffer não sobem ao Syslog server
logging host está ausente no show run
Trap level debugging floodaria e o output mostra level debugging
explicacao_profunda: Trap logging level emergencies com só 2 linhas ao host; buffer tem LINK-3 e SYS-5 que não passam no filtro 0. logging host 10.255.255.50 existe. NTP está synchronized. O gap é trap restritivo demais, não host ausente.

sintoma: Chamado #4303 — SIEM no IP 10.50.50.100 não recebe nada do core. Console e buffer locais mostram eventos normalmente.
cli_output:
Core# show run | include logging|ntp|snmp
service timestamps log datetime msec
logging buffered 32768 informational
logging console informational
logging trap informational
logging host 10.50.50.200
ntp server 10.0.0.1
snmp-server community OpsRO ro

Core# show logging
Syslog logging: enabled
    Console logging: level informational, 120 messages logged
    Buffer logging: level informational, 118 messages logged
    Trap logging: level informational, 115 message lines logged
        Logging to 10.50.50.200 (udp port 514, link up), 115 message lines logged
Log Buffer (32768 bytes):
*Aug 12 14:22:01.001: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin

Core# show ntp status
Clock is synchronized, stratum 2, reference is 10.0.0.1

! Inventário do NOC: SIEM real = 10.50.50.100 (não .200)
alternativas: logging trap está em emergencies e bloqueia tudo
NTP unsynchronized no output
logging host aponta 10.50.50.200 — destino errado; SIEM esperado é .100; trap informational e buffer ok
snmp-server community ausente impede Syslog
explicacao_profunda: Trap informational com 115 linhas para 10.50.50.200; buffer e console ativos; NTP sync. O SIEM do inventário é .100 — host de log errado. Community SNMP não carrega Syslog. Não há trap emergencies nem unsync no recorte.

sintoma: Chamado #4304 — Ferramenta NMS falha autenticação SNMP no switch de acesso. String configurada no NMS: “public”.
cli_output:
SW1# show run | include snmp|ntp|logging
snmp-server community CampusRO ro
snmp-server community CampusRW rw
ntp server 10.0.0.1
logging host 10.50.50.100
logging trap warnings

SW1# show snmp
Chassis: FOC1234X0AB
0 SNMP packets input
    0 Bad Community names
    0 Illegal operation for community name supplied
    0 Encoding errors
0 SNMP packets output

SW1# show ntp status
Clock is synchronized, stratum 3, reference is 10.0.0.1

SW1# show run | include community
snmp-server community CampusRO ro
snmp-server community CampusRW rw
! nenhuma community "public"
alternativas: Agent só tem communities CampusRO/CampusRW — NMS com “public” não autentica (v2c string errada)
logging trap warnings desliga o agent SNMP
NTP stratum 3 proíbe qualquer SNMP
show snmp prova community public ativa
explicacao_profunda: Running só tem CampusRO e CampusRW; public não existe. NMS com public falha community match. NTP sync e logging trap não desligam SNMP. show snmp não lista public. Corrija a string no NMS ou adicione community alinhada (preferir RO para monitor).

sintoma: Chamado #4305 — Após queda de link, o NMS não mostrou alerta SNMP; o buffer local registrou %LINK-3-UPDOWN horas “no passado”. NTP estava off na manutenção.
cli_output:
R2# show run | include ntp|logging|snmp
logging buffered 8192 warnings
logging console warnings
logging trap warnings
logging host 10.50.50.100
snmp-server community Monitor ro
! sem ntp server
! sem snmp-server host / snmp-server enable traps (nenhuma linha de trap destination)

R2# show ntp status
%NTP is not enabled.

R2# show logging
Syslog logging: enabled
    Trap logging: level warnings, 40 message lines logged
        Logging to 10.50.50.100, 40 message lines logged
Log Buffer (8192 bytes):

*Mar  1 01:04:13.000: %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface GigabitEthernet0/1, changed state to down

R2# show snmp
Chassis: FTX9999
0 SNMP packets input
0 SNMP packets output

R2# show clock
*01:10:00.000 UTC Fri Mar 1 2002
alternativas: ntp server e synchronized stratum 1 estão explícitos no output
snmp-server host de traps está configurado e show snmp mostra tráfego alto de traps
Syslog host ausente — contradiz logging host 10.50.50.100
NTP não habilitado (relógio/timestamps ruins) e SNMP só com community RO sem snmp-server host/traps — NMS não recebe traps; eventos ficam no Syslog/buffer
explicacao_profunda: NTP is not enabled e clock em 2002 explicam timestamps “no passado”. Syslog host existe e registrou LINK-3. SNMP tem community mas zero packets e sem snmp-server host/enable traps no include — traps não estão direcionados ao NMS. Dois eixos do chamado: tempo + traps ausentes.
